content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Corporate Relations & Placement Coordinator: MBA/ PGDBM/ M.A. (Economics) from a recognized Institution/ University with 50% marks or equivalent CGPA. Excellent oral and written communication skills in English (Spoken & written). At least five years of successful experience as Placement Officer/ Manager or Placement Head, Training and Placement Officer at any Institute of National importance or a premier business school with a strong corporate network.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: All Posts: Maximum age limit is 55 years (as on last date of receipt of applications).

content_sections.text: Corporate Relations & Placement Coordinator: Rs. 1,00,000/- to Rs. 1,50,000/- per month.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIFT Corporate Relations & Placement Coordinator Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 22-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIFT to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) for hiring qualified professionals on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIFT?
faq.answer: IIFT has advertised openings for the position of Corporate Relations & Placement Coordinator under this current government job notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Corporate Relations & Placement Coordinator post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIFT Corporate Relations & Placement Coordinator Recruitment 2026 is 22-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBA/ PGDBM/ M.A. (Economics) from a recognized Institution/ University with 50% marks along with relevant placement experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 55 years as calculated on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging between Rs. 1,00,000 and Rs. 1,50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can apply through the online mode by following the guidelines given in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIFT Corporate Relations & Placement Coordinator?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a test and an interview conducted for shortlisted candidates at the IIFT Campus.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this position?
faq.answer: The job location for the selected Corporate Relations & Placement Coordinator will be in Kolkata, West Bengal.
